strings.inline.home.title: الاحساء: دنیا کے سب سے بڑے نخلستان کا سیاحتی رہنما
strings.inline.home.description: الاحساء کا سیاحتی رہنما: جبل القارہ، قصر ابراہیم، سوق القیصریہ اور العقیر۔ یونیسکو کے عالمی ورثے میں شامل اس نخلستان کے نقشے، سیر کے راستے، تقریبات اور کھانا پینا۔

strings.home.name.body: “الاحساء” لفظ “حسی” کی جمع ہے، یعنی وہ میٹھا پانی جو ریت کی پتلی تہہ کے نیچے بہتا اور جمع ہوتا ہے؛ ہاتھ سے ریت ہٹائیں تو پھوٹ نکلتا ہے۔ یہ سرزمین ہمیشہ سے ایسی ہی رہی ہے: ایک فیاض نخلستان، جو وہاں زندگی کا وعدہ کرتا ہے جہاں کسی کو اس کی توقع نہیں ہوتی۔ اس کے چشموں اور نہروں کے کنارے چلیں تو آپ سمجھ جائیں گے کہ اسے یہ نام کیسے ملا۔
strings.home.cats.title: نخلستان میں اپنی راہ چنیں

strings.home.route.s1.d: آغاز اس قلعے سے کریں جس کی ایک ہی فصیل کے اندر مسجد، سپاہیوں کی رہائش گاہیں اور برج یکجا ہیں۔
strings.home.route.s3.d: دن میں اوپر چڑھیں اور اپنے قدموں تلے کھجور کے درختوں کا سمندر پھیلتا دیکھیں۔
strings.home.route.s2.d: عطر سے مہکتی اور تانبے سے جگمگاتی گلیاں، اور یہیں کے لوگوں کے ہاتھوں کڑھے ہوئے چغے۔
strings.home.route.s4.d: مٹی کی دیواریں، جو اسلام کی قدیم ترین داستانوں میں سے ایک اپنے اندر سمیٹے ہوئے ہیں۔
strings.home.route.s5.d: ہرے بھرے باغ اور ترشاوہ پھلوں کی مہک، اور اپنے موسم میں، وسط جون سے اگست کے آخر تک، الاحساء کے لیموں کی چنائی۔
strings.home.route.s6.d: اختتام اس قدیم بندرگاہ پر کریں جہاں صحرا کی ریت خلیج کی نیلاہٹ سے جا ملتی ہے۔

changes.why: These three words are the text of a link, and the reader on a phone meets a link before the sentence around it. Two calibration readers said of «وہاں کی انتظامیہ» the same thing: fine Urdu, vague as the thing to tap ('who is "there"?': the mountain, or the village that sells the tickets). «اس مقام کی انتظامیہ» names whose management it is with the batch's own word for the attraction, and stands on its own as a link. It adds nothing: the source's 'the operator' is the operator of the place the page is about, and who that is the source still does not say (calibration source defect SD14, carried). The sentence around it is untouched and reads «… جانے سے پہلے اس مقام کی انتظامیہ سے تصدیق کر لیں۔». One of the nine calibration candidates (P27) is thereby changed: for stage 4 to raise and the blind reader to read in place; the earlier form is the alternative.

changes.before: سیاحتی مقام، تجربہ یا جگہ تلاش کریں…
changes.after: تلاش کریں: سیاحتی مقام، تجربہ یا جگہ…
changes.why: A placeholder that does not fit its input is cut at the end, and the search input is set in large type (.sm-input, --t-lg). In the English the end is the last item of a list; in Urdu it was the verb, the one word that says what the field is for. With the verb first, a narrow phone loses the tail of the list and nothing else. Same four content words, same order among themselves; the string is also the field's accessible name, where 'search: …' reads as naturally.

tempted_but_not_added.what: «25 لاکھ سے زیادہ» for 'more than 2.5 million' in home.hero.lead and on the figure card.
tempted_but_not_added.why_not: It is how this reader counts, and how the Urdu daily published in the Kingdom wrote this very figure («25 لاکھ سے زیادہ کھجوروں کے درخت», recorded under open item P10). But it changes the digits of the source, the scale is an open item to be ruled on evidence, and the stage checker holds every figure to the source. Raised, not written.

tempted_but_not_added.what: «عربی لفظ» before “حسی” in home.name.body, so that the reader does not first see the Urdu adjective.
tempted_but_not_added.why_not: That the word is Arabic is true and is not said in either source; a language label is a fact. The quotation marks, «لفظ» and the meaning that follows already carry the reader. Left for the blind read to show whether it is needed.

tempted_but_not_added.what: A word of explanation after «مفلق» (and «ہریس») in cat.taste.d, or the Pakistani dish this reader would think of.
tempted_but_not_added.why_not: What the dishes are is not in this string in any language, and a comparison with a dish from home is exactly what the fence forbids. The food pages will say what they are when their round comes.

tempted_but_not_added.what: «بشت» instead of, or beside, «چغے» in cat.crafts.d and home.route.s2.d.
tempted_but_not_added.why_not: A reader who lives in the Gulf knows the garment by that name, and it is the Arabic's word. But the English source is generic, the name has no termbase entry, and a name with a gloss cannot stand in a card line. Offered to stage 4 as a termbase question, not written.

tempted_but_not_added.what: A remark on the heat at the lime-picking season in home.route.s5.d (mid-June to the end of August), or advice on the hour of the day.
tempted_but_not_added.why_not: Heat is what this audience plans around, and the season named is the hottest of the year. The source says when the picking is and nothing about how to bear it; the stop already stands under the late-afternoon pill, which is the source's own answer.

tempted_but_not_added.what: «سعودی عرب» in the meta description, as the Chinese line added the country.
tempted_but_not_added.why_not: Useful to a visitor searching from Pakistan, not needed by one who lives in the Kingdom, and in neither source. The country name stands in the structured data (inline.home.country).

tempted_but_not_added.what: «عصر» and «مغرب» for the two time pills ('late afternoon', 'sunset').
tempted_but_not_added.why_not: They are the words this reader tells the afternoon by, and they are short enough for the pill. In Urdu they are first of all the names of prayers: they would put a devotional frame on a sightseeing schedule that the source does not have (the Arabic «آخر العصر» is a time of day).

tempted_but_not_added.what: Where to look for the permission in map.locate.err: «اپنے براؤزر میں …», or the phone's settings.
tempted_but_not_added.why_not: The English and the Arabic do say 'in the browser', and the reader on a phone needs it. The word has no dictionary headword on record (P16), and 'the phone's settings' is not in the source. The string says which permission and whose; the loan is raised for stage 4.

tempted_but_not_added.what: The everyday loans of this reader: «لنک» and «کاپی» in plan.copied, «شیئر» on the share button, «ریسٹورنٹ» and «کیفے» in the dining label, «فارم ہاؤس» for the farms, «مینو» for the menu.
tempted_but_not_added.why_not: Owner's decision P16: no loan where a common Urdu word exists, and none without a dictionary entry; the preference of readers does not open the door. The native wordings stand. The two a blind reader is most likely to stumble on are «ربط» for a link (plan.copied) and «کھیت» for the farms.

tempted_but_not_added.what: Who the operator is, or a telephone number, in the notice under the visit card.
tempted_but_not_added.why_not: The page gives neither (source defect SD14 of the calibration). The link text was made self-standing instead; nothing was added to it.

tempted_but_not_added.what: A weekend frame for the two-day route («ہفتہ وار چھٹی کے لیے»), which is how a resident of the Eastern Province would use it.
tempted_but_not_added.why_not: The source says two days, not which two; 'what fits a weekend' is the reader's own conclusion to draw.

tempted_but_not_added.what: A generic next to «قصر ابراہیم» and «سوق القیصریہ» in the route list and the meta description (a fort, a market).
tempted_but_not_added.why_not: No gloss stands in a label, a list name or a title, and the gloss form for an opaque generic is open (P3c). The plain generics already stand near the names, untouched: «قلعہ» in the line under the first, «بازار» in the card title above the second.

tempted_but_not_added.what: «آنے والوں کے لیے معلومات» for det.visitInfo, because the reader who lives two hours away is a visitor, not a «سیاح».
tempted_but_not_added.why_not: Not a fact but a wording, and the wording in the text is the one all three calibration readers passed and two praised. Evidence in place outweighs a guess about self-image.

notes.text: The table as it stands after stage 3 (one amendment in this pass, marked CHANGED). attraction / sight / landmark / site = «مقام» (pl. «مقامات»; section name «سیاحتی مقامات») · 'sights' in search.placeholder only = «سیاحتی مقام» (full form, because «جگہ» stands in the same list) · place (generic) = «جگہ» · trail / route = «راستہ» · path = «راہ» · stop on a route = «پڑاؤ» · trip / journey = «سفر» · story = «داستان» · heritage (noun) = «ورثہ» · UNESCO World Heritage = «یونیسکو کا عالمی ورثہ» · oasis = «نخلستان» · palms = «کھجور کے درخت» · orchards / groves = «باغ / باغات» · farms (generic) = «کھیت» · parks = «تفریح گاہیں» · springs / channels = «چشمے / نہریں» · the Gulf = «خلیج» · souq (generic) = «بازار» · events = «تقریبات» · festivals = «میلے» · cuisine = «پکوان» · experiences = «تجربات» · crafts = «دستکاری» · category / group = «زمرہ» · guide = «رہنما» / «سیاحتی رہنما» · search = «تلاش» · save (verb) = «محفوظ کریں», saved (toast) = «محفوظ ہو گیا», saved (of the places in the list) = «محفوظ کردہ» · plan (verb) = «منصوبہ بنائیں» · site = «ویب سائٹ» · map = «نقشہ» · home = «صفحہ اول» · discover = «دریافت» · greenery = «ہریالی» · mosques (plural) = «مساجد» · the visitor's location = said as a clause («آپ کہاں ہیں»), no noun · complete (your day) = «بھرپور بنائیں»; round out (a route) = «مکمل کریں» · cloaks = «چغے» · CHANGED: the operator = «اس مقام کی انتظامیہ» (was «وہاں کی انتظامیہ»).

What this pass checked and found already in place, so left alone. Opening hours as a planning constraint: the notice under the card says it in one natural sentence, and its link now says whose management. Distance: «مجھ سے کتنی دور؟» is how this reader asks it, the two results («1 کلومیٹر سے کم», «تقریباً {n} کلومیٹر») and the straight-line caveat are plain. How a site connects to the rest of a day: the nearby heading and the two-day route say it without help. Season: the only season in the batch is the lime-picking window, kept as the source gives it. Nothing in the batch speaks of dress, access, visas or roads, and nothing was added. No devotional framing: «مسجد جواثا» stands in the route as the source has it, a stop with a story. Unfamiliar names: four attraction names stand in labels and lists where no gloss may stand (P3c open).

Read against the components, not measured. (1) The header on a phone shows five things: the wordmark, the search button, the saved-places link with its counter, the language button and the burger; every bar label is inside the burger as a vertical list, so the fuller primaries cost nothing there. The saved-places label is the one navigation label a phone shows at all times (a.plan-link, which may wrap): the choice between «میرے محفوظ کردہ مقامات» and «میرے مقامات» should be measured at 360px as well as on the bar. (2) The route time pills are 68px wide at every width (.route-time); the German line needed its own width there for one long word, the two long Urdu labels («ڈھلتی سہ پہر», «غروب آفتاب») are two words each and can break at the space. (3) The figure card sets «2.5 ملین سے زیادہ» in large type (.fact-n), one card per row on a phone; compact form on record: «2.5 ملین+». (4) The search placeholder is now verb-first (change log). (5) search.escHint speaks of keys a phone does not have; the line is not hidden at narrow widths in any language, and is kept as translated.
